name: origin-power-media-gen
description: Media generation plugin (Origin Power MaaS): text-to-image, image editing, video (4-15s) and music (WAV). No MCP — ships a bundled CLI driven by a skill; a SessionStart hook injects the plugin root path and config status.

description_i18n.en: Media generation plugin (Origin Power MaaS): text-to-image, image editing, video (4-15s) and music (WAV). No MCP — ships a bundled CLI driven by a skill; a SessionStart hook injects the plugin root path and config status.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 媒体生成插件（Origin Power MaaS）：文生图、图片编辑、视频（4-15 秒）、音乐生成（WAV）。无 MCP，随插件分发 CLI，skill 触发，SessionStart 注入插件根路径与配置状态。
